name: 方框切角
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a minimal flat monochrome app icon symbol for Windows Icon Toolkit, an app that edits desktop icon overlays. ONE simple thin-but-bold rounded square outline with a small clean gap cut at its lower-right corner, and a tiny detached square sitting neatly in that gap. Exactly two simple geometric shapes, visual meaning: remove/change the corner badge of an icon. Solid single charcoal color #242424 only, uniform stroke thickness, vector-like precise edges, frontal 2D, quiet modern utility software symbol, optically balanced, works at 16 px. No enclosing app tile, no color accent, no gradients, no shadow, no glow, no 3D, no texture, no pencil, no text, no letters, no particles. Center on a plain pure white square canvas with generous whitespace. This is a simple toolbar-style icon, NOT an elaborate app-store illustration. Single symbol only.

name: 两个角框
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE extremely simple flat monochrome icon for a desktop icon editing utility. Two bold opposing corner brackets form a square icon silhouette, with a short diagonal slash replacing a small portion of its lower right corner to suggest precise editing. Abstract geometric tool symbol, distinctive and effortless to understand, very few strokes, single uniform medium stroke weight with slightly rounded ends, balanced negative space. One solid charcoal black color #242424 on a pure white square canvas, generous whitespace. Must look like a carefully designed simple interface icon at 24 px, not a product illustration. Absolutely no gradients, color accents, shadows, lighting, glow, 3D, texture, extra ornaments, text, letters, Windows logo or surrounding rounded-square app background. Single symbol only.

name: 图标擦除
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE minimal flat monochrome icon for Windows Icon Toolkit: a simple rounded-square outline representing an application icon, with a tiny geometric eraser crossing only its lower-right corner. A very small blank gap in the square outline where the eraser touches communicates removal of icon badges. One plain outline plus one tiny solid eraser, no interior app-grid or other decorations. Bold precise geometry, uniform strokes, clean silhouette, excellent legibility at 16 and 24 px, like a professional minimalist interface icon. Single solid charcoal color #242424 on pure white square background with generous whitespace. No other colors, no gradients, no shadows, no glow, no 3D, no texture, no pencil, no text, no letters, no branding, no app tile background. Single finished symbol only.
